description: Professional video generation prompts for AI models (Runway, Veo3, Kling, Wan2.1, Seedance). Researched from openshorts, TwitCanva, and professional video AI platforms. DNA-adaptive — replace [BRAND], [PRODUCT], [COLOR] placeholders.

templates.name: UGC Product Discovery Hook
templates.prompt: Handheld vertical smartphone footage, slight camera shake, natural window light. A young woman in her mid-20s sits at a kitchen table, holding a [PRODUCT] toward camera. She speaks directly to lens in a conversational tone: 'Okay I need to tell you about this.' Close-up on product label, then back to her face. Authentic reaction. Background is slightly out of focus — real apartment, coffee mug visible. No color grading. Raw, TikTok native style.

templates.name: UGC Before/After Reveal
templates.prompt: POV walking shot, handheld, slight motion blur on corners. User walks into a [SPACE], camera pans to messy/old state. Cut to same angle — clean/new state with [PRODUCT] prominently placed. Subject glances at camera and gives a small thumbs up. Authentic Gen Z aesthetic, vertical 9:16 format, no text overlays. Natural apartment lighting.

templates.name: UGC Unboxing Reaction
templates.prompt: Top-down handheld shot of hands opening a [BRAND] branded cardboard box on a wooden table. Natural daylight from left side. Fingers pull tissue paper aside revealing [PRODUCT]. Camera tilts up to show genuine surprised smile, phone panned slightly crooked. Ambient room sounds implied. Raw, unedited feel. iPhone-style footage quality.

templates.name: UGC 5-Segment Short (openshorts structure)
templates.prompt: 25-second viral short structured in 5 segments: (1) Hook 0-5s: [HOOK_LINE] — direct to camera, handheld, surprised expression; (2) Problem B-roll 5-9s: cinematic background clip showing [PROBLEM_VISUAL]; (3) Solution 9-16s: presenter demonstrates [PRODUCT] solving problem, authentic reaction; (4) Demo B-roll 16-21s: [PRODUCT] in use, satisfying motion; (5) CTA 21-25s: presenter looks at camera, natural gesture toward product. Consistent vertical 9:16, TikTok-native aesthetic throughout.

templates.name: Explode-View Tech Product
templates.prompt: Cinematic product visualization. [PRODUCT] centered on pure black background. Camera starts tight on product. Smooth explosion outward: individual components separate in 3D space — [COMPONENTS_LIST] — each floating with gentle rotation, illuminated by cool blue rim lighting against void black. Components pause mid-air for 1.5 seconds. Reverse implosion: all parts fly back together in precise order. Final frame: assembled product with lens flare. Ultra-sharp, 4K quality, slow motion.

templates.name: Explode-View Skincare Formula Reveal
templates.prompt: Premium beauty product explode view. [PRODUCT] centered on white marble surface. Camera orbits slowly right. Glass bottle fragments outward in slow motion revealing the [FORMULA_COLOR] formula inside, which transforms into floating botanical ingredient icons — [INGREDIENTS_LIST]. Each element spins gently in golden studio light. [BRAND_COLORS] color palette. Ingredients converge back into bottle. Elegant, high-end cosmetic brand aesthetic.

templates.name: Explode-View Sneaker Component Reveal
templates.prompt: Athletic footwear explode view. [BRAND] [MODEL] sneaker on gradient gray studio floor. Dramatic explosion: sole separates in layers (rubber outsole, foam midsole, insole), upper mesh peels away revealing internal structure, laces float free. Each layer illuminated by edge-catch lighting, rotating slowly in zero gravity. Layers reassemble with kinetic snap. Hype-brand energy, cinematic slow motion. Color palette: [BRAND_COLORS].

templates.name: Real Estate — Luxury Villa Aerial Approach
templates.prompt: Aerial drone shot approaching a [STYLE] villa at golden hour. Camera glides low over an infinity pool reflecting orange sky, sweeping around to face the main facade. Lush [VEGETATION_TYPE] landscaping frames both sides. Camera smoothly descends toward double-door entrance. Warm 5600K magic-hour sunlight, long shadows. Cinematic color grade: lifted shadows, warm highlights, slight teal shadows. No people. Pristine, aspirational real estate aesthetic.

templates.name: Real Estate — Interior Walkthrough Reveal
templates.prompt: Ground-level camera pushes slowly through a glass pivot door into a modernist [ROOM_TYPE]. Natural morning light streams through floor-to-ceiling windows. Camera tracks forward past a [FEATURE_1], past a [FEATURE_2], and settles on [HERO_VIEW]. Smooth gimbal motion, 24fps cinematic. Warm white interior, minimal furniture, no people. Architectural photography style. Color grade: [BRAND_PALETTE].

templates.name: Real Estate — Alpine Chalet Panorama
templates.prompt: Drone rises from snow-covered terrace of a luxury mountain chalet, revealing a 180-degree panorama of an alpine valley. Camera rotates clockwise to show cedar-clad facade with stone chimney, smoke rising gently. Warm interior lights glow through triple-glazed windows against blue dusk sky. Cinematic color grade with cool exterior, warm interior contrast. No people. Premium ski chalet real estate quality. Property: [PROPERTY_NAME], location: [LOCATION].

templates.name: Brand Film — Craftsmanship Origin Story
templates.prompt: Cinematic commercial style. Open on macro shot: craftsman hands working [MATERIAL] at a workbench, warm incandescent workshop light. Camera slowly pulls back to reveal a full artisan workshop. Time-lapse of craft process: [PROCESS_STEPS]. Final shot: hands hold up a completed [PRODUCT] — camera slowly rotates around it. Shallow depth of field. [BRAND_COLORS] tones, film grain. Luxury heritage brand aesthetic for [BRAND_NAME].

templates.name: Brand Film — Athlete Manifesto
templates.prompt: High-speed cinematic. Athlete in [BRAND_NAME] branded gear sprints toward camera at dawn on empty [LOCATION_TYPE]. Slow motion: feet striking wet pavement, spray in arc. Camera rotates 180 degrees behind runner as sun crests horizon. Cut to macro on determined face, sweat detail. Dramatic rack focus to logo on [PRODUCT]. Desaturated with crushed blacks, aggressive contrast, cool blue shadows, warm skin tones. Championship energy.

templates.name: Social Shorts — Product Hook Reel
templates.prompt: Vertical 9:16 format. Fast-paced lifestyle edit. 3 quick scenes: (1) aerial [PRODUCT] flat lay with dramatic spin, (2) close-up hand picking up product with satisfying motion blur, (3) lifestyle shot — [PRODUCT] in use in a [SETTING]. Each scene 2 seconds. Bright, high-contrast, [BRAND_COLORS] palette. TikTok native energy. Motion transitions between scenes. No text. Loopable ending that returns to opening composition.

templates.name: Social Shorts — POV Discovery Reel
templates.prompt: Vertical format. First-person POV shot walking into a [SETTING], camera looks down at hands placing [PRODUCT] on [SURFACE] beside [PROP]. Camera tilts up to [LIGHT_SOURCE]. Smooth, aesthetically satisfying, ASMR pacing. [BRAND_TONES] tones, soft shadows, minimal depth of field. Lifestyle aesthetic meets product placement. Duration: 6 seconds.

templates.name: AI Avatar — Corporate Explainer Presenter
templates.prompt: Professional AI presenter video. Photorealistic human presenter, [PRESENTER_DESCRIPTION]. Framed waist-up against a softly blurred [BACKGROUND_STYLE] background with light bokeh. Professional 3-point studio lighting, soft key light from left, subtle fill right. She speaks looking directly at camera, natural hand gestures. Neutral, authoritative presentation style. [BRAND_COLORS] color palette. Photorealistic skin detail, natural eye movement. Brand-safe quality.

templates.name: AI Avatar — Conversational Social Presenter
templates.prompt: Casual AI presenter, [PRESENTER_DESCRIPTION], in a bright minimal [SETTING] setting. Seated slightly off-center, camera at eye level. Natural window light from right side. Presenter leans slightly toward camera with engaged, friendly energy, gesturing with one hand. Relaxed, YouTube creator energy. Slight ambient room audio implied. Authentic feel, not overly polished. Vertical 9:16 format.

templates.name: Cinematic — 360° Product Orbit
templates.prompt: Premium product commercial. [PRODUCT] on [SURFACE] under dramatic studio lighting. Camera performs a slow 360-degree orbit around the product, starting low and rising slightly. Specular highlights trace across the [MATERIAL_FINISH] surface. Shallow depth of field, bokeh background in [BRAND_COLORS]. Product never leaves frame center. Final shot: camera stops front-facing with perfect hero framing. Ultra-clean, no people. Luxury commercial aesthetic.

templates.name: Immersive — Full Property Tour
templates.prompt: Luxury property tour sequence for [PROPERTY_NAME]. Scene 1 (0-5s): aerial drone approach revealing full exterior at magic hour, warm light on [FACADE_STYLE] facade. Scene 2 (5-10s): smooth ground-level push through main entrance into [MAIN_LIVING_AREA], camera reveals [SIGNATURE_FEATURE]. Scene 3 (10-15s): camera drifts toward [HERO_VIEW] — [VIEW_DESCRIPTION]. Seamless transitions between scenes. Cinematic color grade throughout: warm interior, cool exterior contrast. No people. [PRICE_BRACKET] real estate quality.

templates.name: Prompt Optimizer (TwitCanva-style)
templates.prompt: You are an expert video prompt engineer specialized in AI video generation models (Runway Gen-4, Veo 3.1, Kling, Wan2.1, Seedance). Your task: take the user's raw idea and rewrite it as a precise, visual, technically-optimized generation prompt. Rules: (1) Specify camera movement (dolly, orbit, push-in, handheld, drone); (2) Describe lighting precisely (golden hour, 3-point studio, natural window); (3) Include motion detail (slow motion, timelapse, real-time); (4) Specify aspect ratio if implied by content (16:9 cinematic, 9:16 social); (5) Keep under 80 words; (6) Output ONLY the rewritten prompt.

tips: Specify camera type: dolly, orbit, crane, handheld
Describe motion velocity: slow, moderate, fast

veo3.1.strength: Temporal coherence, complex scenes, audio sync

tips: Route v2.6 through fal.ai for motion control

cost_routing_strategy.hero_clips: runway-gen4 or veo3.1 — best quality for hero moments
cost_routing_strategy.broll_clips: wan2.1-t2v via Replicate — cost optimized for background clips
cost_routing_strategy.ugc_style: kling-v1.6 — best subject consistency for person-based content
cost_routing_strategy.parallel_batch: Submit all simultaneously, use semaphore(3) for rate limit safety
cost_routing_strategy.caching: Hash prompt+model+params to skip regen if file exists and size > 0
